mapper.select: SELECT n.*, u.username AS author_name FROM news n LEFT JOIN user u ON n.author_id = u.user_id ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
SELECT n.*, u.username AS author_name FROM news n LEFT JOIN user u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.news_id = #{newsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news (title, tag, content, views, author_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{tag}, #{content}, 0, #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE news SET title = #{title}, tag = #{tag}, content = #{content} WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
